verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that AgentMail's enterprise options include "Bring Your Own Cloud", which suggests the core service can be deployed in a customer's own cloud. No first-party docs describe a self-hosted deployment, and every documented surface (API, hosted MCP server, IMAP/SMTP) points to a vendor-hosted service. The MIT-licensed SDKs are client libraries, not the core product, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of self-hosting or BYOC, deployment artifacts or install guides, availability outside enterprise contracts, clarity on whether BYOC is customer-operated or vendor-managed, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
